init.title: Connection to the lamp
init.description: Lamps on the same Bluetooth proxy must all connect the same way.

data_description.connection: Stay connected: the lamp reports every change at once. Connect only when needed: Home Assistant connects for a change or a read and disconnects again, one lamp at a time.
data_description.poll_interval: Only when connecting when needed: minutes between two reads of the lamp's brightness, each over a short connection. 0 never reads it; the state is then what Home Assistant last set.
data_description.power_check_interval: Only when connecting when needed: seconds between two checks that the lamp still advertises, without a connection. A lamp that was not heard since the previous check has no power and turns unavailable. 0 leaves this to Home Assistant, which takes a few minutes.
data_description.visit_limit: Only when connecting when needed: the most visits to the lamp, each a connection for a change or a read, within the window below. The next one waits. A lamp that is connected to too often in a short time stops advertising until its power is cut. 0 sets no limit.
data_description.visit_window: Only when connecting when needed: the length in seconds of the window that the limit counts in.
data_description.connect_twice: Open every connection, close it and open it again before use. A connection that has to look up the lamp's services, after a restart of Home Assistant or of the Bluetooth proxy, reaches a lamp that doesn't carry out what it is told, or stalls; the second connection doesn't have to look them up. Off saves a second or more per connection.
data_description.connect_attempts: How many times in a row Home Assistant tries to connect before it gives up for this time.
data_description.retry_interval: Seconds until the next attempt after a connection that failed. Until it succeeds the lamp is unavailable. The attempts after that follow after 2, 6 and 12 times as long.

command_failed.message: The lamp did not accept the command: {error}

name_too_long.message: The name takes {length} bytes in UTF-8; the lamp stores at most {max}.
